link.note: First name Elizabeth probable; the Leggett surname and her motherhood of Charity are speculative ('believed' to be a Leggett sister, Giles & Franklin p.xvii).

summary: Possible 8th-great-grandmother of John; second wife of Capt. Thomas Davenport.
bio: Capt. Thomas Davenport's second wife Elizabeth was 'believed' to be a Leggett sister. Round 2 listed her as Charity's mother but flagged 'check which wife was Charity's mother'. WikiTree's chain Leggett -> Richardson -> Mead of Watford rests on the belief.
sources: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport, Philipstown Pioneer 1682-1759, and his Descendants (1962): https://archive.org/details/thomasdavenportp00gile (also HathiTrust wu.89066038563: https://babel.hathitrust.org/cgi/pt?id=wu.89066038563&view=1up&seq=395) p.xvii
